snippet.title: Football Chairman Promo Video
snippet.description: Top-selling iOS/Android app: build your own football empire! Create a football club from scratch, starting as a tiny non-league team, and see if you can make it through seven divisions to the very top. Download links at www.football-chairman.com. Video made by wooshii.com.
